top_signals.title: Japan-controlled tankers return to Middle East after months away
top_signals.summary: Over more than seven months of conflict in the Persian Gulf, Japan's risk-averse tankers have stayed away, but that appears to be changing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bank of America fined $1.2 billion over money-laundering violations
top_signals.summary: The action by the Treasury Department was announced less than a day before Bank of America reports quarterly earnings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Speculation Over STT Cut Lifts Sentiment for Indian Stocks
top_signals.summary: Nifty jumps as traders seize on a rather noncommittal remark by Sitharaman about the securities transaction tax.
